CONTAINMENT -- Quick Reference (v0.1 prototype)

Deck size: 60+ cards (these starters are exactly 60). Max 4 copies of a card name, except Basic Facilities.
Start: 20 Stability, 7-card opening hand, Breach 0, max hand size 7.

Turn order: Refresh -> Breach -> Draw -> Main -> Combat -> Second Main -> End.

Breach Track (0-10, shared): 0-2 Stable | 3-4 Unstable | 5-6 Danger | 7-9 Critical | 10 Catastrophic Breach.
Catastrophic Breach (at 10): each player loses 2 Stability, all Contained Anomalies are Released, each player Exhausts one Ready Facility, then Breach resets to 5.

Resources: normally deploy one Facility per turn. Facilities generate Energy. Research is a persistent secondary resource.
Signature systems: Breach Track, Suppression, Containment/Release, Threat ratings, Research.

Authority (Control/Midrange): Secure. Contain. Preserve.
Ruin (Aggressive Risk/Release): Release. Exploit. Transcend.

Competitive side deck: 15 cards. This is a design prototype -- costs, wording and quantities are subject to playtesting.
